status.summary: Retired. Former interim UFC lightweight champion who retired after losing a unanimous decision to Max Holloway at UFC 318 in Louisiana (Jul 19, 2025). Pro record 30-10 (1 NC). In May 2026 he talked about returning for a Diaz fight, but in July 2026 he told Ariel Helwani he is '90%, 95%' sure he will never fight again and that he and Justin Gaethje agreed not to fight a trilogy. Sherdog still described him as retired on Nov 4, 2026. No fight booked, no ranking, no reported injury.

style.summary: A southpaw boxer-puncher who goes looking for exchanges: 80% of his landed significant strikes go to the head and he scored knockdowns at twice the division rate. He backs his boxing with a dangerous front-headlock and guillotine game and has finished elite opponents both ways, but in his last years he took heavy damage and lost to the top grapplers and kickers of his era.

moves.notes: Group weights (head, body, leg) each sum to 1; the engine's target split should come from fighters.json, where recency-weighted landed shares are head 0.83 / body 0.10 / leg 0.07 and attempt shares are head 0.90 / body 0.06 / leg 0.04 (career landed 0.80/0.10/0.10). Head group leans on the southpaw left straight (cross) and hooks, as in his UFC 257, 299 and 318 bouts, which ended by punches or went the distance with 94 of 109 landed to the head vs Holloway (raw bout stats). Kicks to the head are rare; his leg work is mainly calf kicks (UFC 257: 18 leg strikes landed), so calf outweighs inside. Spinning is 0: none appears in his recent finishes. Knee and elbow are small: about 15% of his landed strikes come in the clinch (career). These weights are an analyst judgment from the bout stats above, not a published breakdown.
